description: VAREX HUD 90052 pre-foreclosure sale closing worksheet contract with case metadata, purchaser records, payable items, and approvals.
instructions: Extract only values explicitly stated in the HUD 90052 closing worksheet. Do not infer, calculate, reconcile, split combined values, or populate a missing value. Extract every populated purchaser and payable-from-sales-proceeds entry as a separate item in document order. Preserve combined signature-and-date and item-detail strings exactly as stated. Return null when the source does not state a scalar value and an empty array when it states no repeated entries.

phone_number.description: Phone number of the mortgagee contact person.

seller_initials_and_date.description: Seller initials and date exactly as stated together.

sales_agent_broker_signature_and_date.description: Sales agent or broker signature name and date exactly as stated together.

mortgagee_authorizing_official_signature.description: Mortgagee authorizing official signature name and date exactly as stated together.

closing_agent_signature_and_date.description: Closing agent signature name and date exactly as stated together.

purchaser_info.description: Every populated purchaser entry in document order.

purchaser_details.description: Purchaser details exactly as stated in the populated row.

payable_from_sales_proceeds.description: Every populated item payable from sales proceeds in document order.

item_details.description: Payable item description and amount exactly as stated together.

document_rules.description: Check that the case, homeowner, property, purchaser, payable-item, and approval details are present.
